• Imaging Correlation
• Clinical Change Detection

• Outcome Analysis

AI cannot independently determine surgical indication or operative strategy.

MVP Relevance:
MEDIUM-HIGH

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Pediatric neurosurgery retains longitudinal disease/procedure/device identity, source imaging and functional baseline. Surgical indication, operative strategy, emergency imaging and intraoperative monitoring remain qualified human decisions. Preserve current versus historical device configuration; read access does not permit programming or control.
